reviews.text: Very kind, professional, and understanding with a dog who is very fearful of vets, and an owner who also gets nervous. They are experienced and know what they are doing. They always try to find an opening, even if it's just a short appointment, in case of an emergency. I am very grateful for the kind treatment I received, especially for my dog's well-being. Thank you
A great place, they treat you very well, highly recommended

I always take my little Rambo 😁 to get his nails trimmed or for a check-up, and they're very kind to him 👍 They treat him with love and patience. I highly recommend them 💯 Thank you for treating our beloved pets so well 🫶🫶🫶 …
It's okay, it's not the best but they do the job well.

I've been taking my two dogs to this clinic since we moved to this area, and honestly, I couldn't be happier. I'm quite particular about vets, as my dogs are like family to me, and I want to give them the best. At this clinic, they've always treated us with such empathy and professionalism. They inspire a lot of confidence in me, something I truly value.

One of my dogs is older, and we need to go quite often for various reasons, and every time we go, I feel like she's in the best hands. They always provide the care they need, in a warm and thorough way. There's no better place to entrust my dogs' health. I'm delighted with the treatment and service!

Highly recommended, without a doubt.

They genuinely care about animals and always prioritize their well-being. They work with great empathy and do a fantastic job. I still go to this clinic even though I've moved to a different neighborhood because the care, trust, and peace of mind they provide are unmatched.

They treat your pets with great professionalism.
A 10 out of 10

They are wonderful. I can only thank them for these years of professional and personal support. Always by our side. Wonderful in their approach and empathy during the most difficult times. Thank you for everything. We couldn't have chosen better partners on this adventure. Thank you from Hash. And thank you from me, for your constant support.
They are amazing, I have nothing but words of gratitude for them, for how they care for and treat my animals. I don't care how many kilometers I have to travel, I wouldn't trade them for anyone.
I'm very happy with them; she's always been my trusted vet. I have two dogs.

I looked at several clinics to take my kitten Romeo to the vet for the first time and I decided on this one and I don't regret it at all. The staff are so lovely, the way they treat you and explain everything was wonderful. I was delighted 🥰 and I've already decided to stay at this amazing clinic. I highly recommend it. …
They are very sweet Veterinarians. I brought my Niña, for digestive problems and she is very irritable. But with a lot of love, they have managed it.
The girls were friendly and professional, they know how to handle dogs 🐶 and always have a smile! Thank you so much 🙏🏼 …
I took Lennon, my dachshund, for vaccinations and other appointments, and now they've told me I can take his things to the animal shelter.
I've been taking my cats for years and always excellent service

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic in Nou Barris. The staff are very friendly and professional. It's clear they love animals, which is wonderful. The vet gave my cat a thorough check-up. My cat, Duke, was delighted with them. They microchipped him, dewormed him, gave him his vaccination record, and discharged him. Duke is now calm and happy. Thank you.
They were very attentive and professional with both us and our cats. We think they have excellent judgment and don't order unnecessary tests or visits.
